🏢 MI SB 1050 — Data Centers Could Face New Community Rules in Michigan

Michigan could require new data centers to negotiate agreements with local governments. This means if you're planning a data center, you’ll need to get approval from your county or city – and that approval will depend on whether the agreement benefits the local community, like funding local projects or addressing public health concerns. ...
